Use case: ui-mockup. ONE real Lighthouse component LH03-0021「コミュニティの主要操作」.
Reference priority: Image1 ORIGINAL controls glyph anatomy, optical weight, proportions and fine details. Image2 saved mock is secondary for Japanese copy and logical390x90 layout; fix its omitted ADD badge on member icon and broad mint surfaces. Image3 approved white/forestgreen/slate style only.
Exactly THREE equal white rounded action tiles in a single horizontal row, width112 height74 with16px gaps within390x90 logical component. Left tile original outline person WITH small circular plus badge at lower right; exact label「メンバーを追加」below. Middle original two overlapping outline people, exact label「グループを追加」below. Right original magnifying glass, exact「検索」below. Match original glyph outlines/roundcap weight and relative sizes; member addition MUST have plus badge (mock incorrectly shows plain person). No other icons, counts, title, avatar, tabs, description, outer app header or phone.
LOCKED typography: all3labels Meiryo Regular12px/16px tracking0; centered singleline, original uniform size. Do not make bold or enlarge label role. Icons above labels with same source/native vertical rhythm; preserve exact Japanese wording.
Purewhite#FFFFFF page AND tile backgrounds. Fine neutral tile border, gentle soft shadow,12px corners. No mint fill or green pagewash. This is one coherent group of3available primary community actions; adapt original common green action glyphs to the SAME forestgreen#1F6444 with restrained deepbrand#174C36/highlight#2D8F5E gradient depth on the icon strokes/badge only. Preserve WHITE tile faces and dark labels#1D1D1D. Tiny filled plusbadge has white plus. No separate colors per icon, no selected state, no decorative color. No extra round icon containers or filled tile buttons.
Landscape output with this short wide component centered prominently and modest margins; preserve compact geometry and legibility, no clipping. Static raster design candidate.
